page.overview:
What is Inferius?

An Inferius (pl. Inferi) was a dead body reanimated by a Dark wizard's curse. They were similar to, but intrinsically distinct from, a zombie. which was the art of raising the dead. The spells used to reanimate the corpse were very complex.

There was once a Relic that was able to summon Inferi and heal those afflicted by Dark Magic by the way of a sacrifice. It was first discovered by a student of Salazar Slytherin in the first millennium A.D., who recorded in his notes. Eventually, Sebastian Sallow sought out this artefact in the hopes of curing his sister, Anne, from a curse. Upon getting his hands on it, Sebastian summoned a horde of Inferi that he could control, endangering the town of Feldcroft, until the artefact was destroyed by his uncle, Solomon Sallow.

During the 1890–1891 school year many locations within the Highlands around Hogwarts Castle were infested with Inferi. Some were placed in tombs to guard the treasures within such as the Feldcroft Catacombs, and some were raised by Victor Rookwood and his gang in order to further their goals. Bardolph Beaumont was a victim of the Ashwinders, who killed him and raised him as an Inferius to serve them. Many of these Inferi were destroyed when a Hogwarts student who could see traces of ancient magic explored several of the tombs, catacombs, and caves around the Hogwarts Valley.

In 1899, it was mentioned that the Dark wizard, Gellert Grindelwald, sought to create an army of Inferi, and believed that the Resurrection Stone could grant him such powers. It is unknown as to whether he succeeded, though his conception of the stone's abilities was in fact incorrect, as it brings back souls from the realm of the dead as more-than-ghost but less-than-alive state, not as a living body.
